scope: Owner-scoped file/ZIP/image cancellation and active protection production chain; own generated images and temporary Copy/Host/SQLite only. No GUI, active user library, credential, profile or shared REA access.

api.files.prepare: Registers an AbortController synchronously at request arrival, including queued operations; same signal reaches shared admission and ZIP; checks after Host/Sharp/filesystem awaits.
api.files.hasActive: true until actual current/queued operation finally, including owned stream close and permit release
api.files.cancel: async actor-only cancel followed by actual idle barrier; completed retained copies remain
api.files.whenIdle: async actual actor current/queued completion barrier
api.media.cancel/revoke: cancel and await both owned write completion and files completion
